EXACT LOWER-PROFILE CLAIM

 I_{q,p}(f)=s^(-1/q)(s^(1/p)f s^(1/p))^(p/q)s^(-1/q),
 q=p/(p-1), s=sqrt(sigma),
 E_p^L(f)=p/[2(p-1)] Tr[s I_{q,p}(f)s L(f)].

Then the candidate UNIVERSAL COMPLETE LOWER profile is

 E_p^L(f)>=c_nr(p) E_2^L(I_{2,p}(f)),

                  /[2(p-1)(1+|cos(pi/p)|)].             (T)

stationary reference weight tau_R tensor sigma, and EVERY full joint positive

For p2, c_nr(2)=1 and the result is equality. For p->1, c_nr->pi/4,
consistent with the separately frozen FORWARD entropy bound J_L>=pi E_sym/2.
The original KT E_1 for L corresponds instead to J of its KMS adjoint.
